references.text: God tests Abraham's faith by asking him to sacrifice his son Isaac, demonstrating the ultimate level of loyalty and prioritizing God even above beloved family members.
Moses chooses to suffer with God's people rather than enjoy the fleeting pleasures of sin, showing that God's will takes precedence over family and cultural ties.
Jesus teaches that disciples must place him above close family relationships to be his followers, reflecting the same principle of prioritizing one's relationship with Jesus above all else.
